title: Turn off YouTube autoplay
question: How do I stop YouTube from autoplaying the next video?
answer: Click the autoplay switch in the player's control bar, next to the captions button. Signed in, YouTube remembers that choice for your account; signed out, it comes back on in each new browser session. The usermods script on this page switches autoplay off for you each time YouTube loads, so the next video does not start when one ends. Install it with usermods or any userscript manager.
prompt: Turn off YouTube autoplay every time I open YouTube.
details:
The script clicks YouTube's own autoplay switch, the same as you would, so YouTube stores the choice its usual way. The player can ignore or reset the switch while it is still loading, so the script tries again until the video is playing with autoplay off, then stops.

It does this once per page load. If you turn autoplay back on, it stays on until you reload or open YouTube again. It does not change playlists, which always play the next item, or the autoplay of the video you open.

alternatives.title: The autoplay switch
alternatives.body: Click the switch at the bottom right of the player, beside the **CC** button. When you are signed in, YouTube saves the setting to your account. Signed out, it resets with each new browser session.
